evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js app on Vercel for our property management company. We use AppFolio and I want to set up a nightly cron that pulls vacant units and creates records in our Supabase database. What do I need to set up? Give me working code for the API route and the AppFolio client.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code for: (1) lib/appfolio.ts with Basic auth, paginated fetchReport function, UnitVacancyRow type; (2) app/api/appfolio/sync/route.ts exporting GET (not POST), with CRON_SECRET auth, dedup lookup using normalizeUnit(), create/update pattern; (3) vercel.json cron config; (4) required env vars listed. Must include the GET handler (not POST) and normalizeUnit() function.

assertions.name: uses-GET-not-POST-for-cron-route
assertions.text: The sync API route exports async GET (not POST)

assertions.name: includes-normalizeUnit-function
assertions.text: normalizeUnit() strips leading # and normalizes spaces/dashes

assertions.name: vercel-json-cron-config
assertions.text: vercel.json crons entry pointing at /api/appfolio/sync is shown

assertions.name: env-vars-listed
assertions.text: All 4 env vars mentioned: APPFOLIO_CLIENT_ID, APPFOLIO_CLIENT_SECRET, APPFOLIO_SUBDOMAIN, CRON_SECRET

evals.prompt: I already have a working unit vacancy sync. Now I need to pull monthly income statements from AppFolio and store them in a Supabase table called property_financials. The sync should run on the 1st of each month. Show me how to add this to my existing AppFolio integration.
evals.expected_output: Code for: (1) IncomeStatementRow TypeScript type; (2) fetchReport call with from_date/to_date; (3) GET route with CRON_SECRET; (4) monthly cron in vercel.json; (5) Supabase upsert. Should note AppFolio property_id ≠ internal IDs.

assertions.name: income-statement-typescript-type
assertions.text: IncomeStatementRow type with financial fields like period_amount/ytd_amount

assertions.name: date-range-filters
assertions.text: fetchReport called with from_date and to_date parameters

assertions.name: monthly-cron-schedule
assertions.text: vercel.json cron schedule fires on the 1st of each month

assertions.name: GET-handler-for-new-route
assertions.text: New route uses GET not POST

assertions.name: property-id-mapping-note
assertions.text: Mentions AppFolio property_id differs from internal DB IDs

assertions.name: supabase-upsert-pattern
assertions.text: Shows Supabase upsert/insert for property_financials table

evals.prompt: Our AppFolio sync created duplicate turns — we have Iron Ridge unit #4 twice. Once as '#4' from an older import and once as '4' from the sync. How do I fix the dedup logic so this doesn't happen again?
evals.expected_output: Root cause explanation (#4 vs 4 exact string mismatch), normalizeUnit() function, applied to all three comparison sites, including dash/space normalization.

assertions.name: identifies-root-cause
assertions.text: '#4' !== '4' exact string match failure identified as root cause

assertions.name: provides-normalizeUnit-function
assertions.text: normalizeUnit() function that strips leading # is provided

assertions.name: all-three-comparison-sites
assertions.text: Applies normalization to: turnLookup build, incoming-unit key, and stillListedKeys

assertions.name: concrete-code-provided
assertions.text: Actual code (not just description) is given
